title: The General Theory of Homogenization: A Personalized Introduction
venue: Springer, Lecture Notes of the Unione Matematica Italiana 7
annotation: Develops H-convergence and compensated compactness, the weak-convergence theory of limits of partial differential equations with oscillating coefficients.

title: Homogenization and Two-Scale Convergence
annotation: Introduces two-scale convergence, which passes to the limit in periodically oscillating equations and yields the cell problem and the corrector at once.

authors: Armstrong, S., Kuusi, T. and Mourrat, J.-C.
title: Quantitative Stochastic Homogenization and Large-Scale Regularity
annotation: Gives rates of convergence and the fluctuations of the corrector for divergence-form elliptic equations with stationary random coefficients in space.

title: The perturbed test function method for viscosity solutions of nonlinear PDE
venue: Proceedings of the Royal Society of Edinburgh, Section A 111(3-4):359-375
annotation: Extends the perturbed test function method to viscosity solutions, giving homogenization for fully nonlinear and Hamilton-Jacobi equations.

title: Stochastic Homogenization of Nonconvex Hamilton-Jacobi Equations: A Counterexample
venue: Communications on Pure and Applied Mathematics 70(9):1798-1809
annotation: Constructs a stationary ergodic nonconvex Hamilton-Jacobi equation in two dimensions that does not homogenize.

title: A Strange Term Coming from Nowhere
venue: In Topics in the Mathematical Modelling of Composite Materials, Birkhauser, 45-93
annotation: Shows that a Dirichlet problem in a domain with many small holes has a limit with an extra zero-order term that no averaging of the coefficients produces.

title: An Introduction to Gamma-Convergence
venue: Birkhauser, Progress in Nonlinear Differential Equations and Their Applications 8
annotation: The textbook on Gamma-convergence, the notion of convergence of energy functionals under which minimizers converge.

authors: Hou, T. Y. and Wu, X.-H.
title: A Multiscale Finite Element Method for Elliptic Problems in Composite Materials and Porous Media
annotation: Builds finite-element basis functions from local solutions of the oscillating equation, so that a coarse grid carries the effective behaviour.
